prompt: I have a bunch of HR policy PDFs in SAP SuccessFactors that I want our Gemini Enterprise agent to be able to cite. Help me build the connector — we use Workday for SSO and SAP user IDs don't match Google emails.

assertions.name: recommends_ingestion_not_mcp
assertions.text: Recommends a Discovery Engine ingestion connector (not an MCP server) because the content is static documents that need to be cited and ACL-enforced at query time.

assertions.name: uses_identity_mapping_store
assertions.text: Identifies that an Identity Mapping Store is required because SAP user IDs do not match Google Workspace identities, and shows how to create one BEFORE the datastore (it cannot be added later).

assertions.name: acl_enabled_at_creation
assertions.text: Sets acl_enabled=True at datastore creation time and explains that it cannot be added later.

assertions.name: ims_referenced_at_datastore_creation
assertions.text: Passes the identity_mapping_store reference into create_data_store using the full resource name format (projects/.../identityMappingStores/...).

assertions.name: external_identity_prefix_correct
assertions.text: Documents the asymmetry: external identities are imported WITHOUT the external_user:/external_group: prefix, but referenced WITH the prefix in document ACLs.

assertions.name: stable_doc_ids_from_source_pk
assertions.text: Uses stable document IDs derived from the SAP source primary key, not random UUIDs.

assertions.name: pdf_mime_type_handled
assertions.text: Handles PDF binary content via raw_bytes with mime_type=application/pdf, relying on Discovery Engine server-side extraction.

assertions.name: uses_google_cloud_discoveryengine_sdk
assertions.text: Uses the google-cloud-discoveryengine Python SDK (DocumentServiceClient, DataStoreServiceClient, IdentityMappingStoreServiceClient).

assertions.name: fetch_transform_sync_structure
assertions.text: Organizes the connector code into the three-stage Fetch → Transform → Sync pipeline.

assertions.name: scheduled_sync_mentioned
assertions.text: Mentions scheduled sync (e.g., Cloud Scheduler + Cloud Run job) and the FULL vs. INCREMENTAL reconciliation distinction.
